machines.name: Mass Ton Mover
machines.summary: Cuts diversion channels and grades pads. Banks regolith as fill and local stone.

machines.name: Raw Earth Miner
machines.summary: Opens a borrow pit and banks local stone from frozen ground.

machines.name: Biological Monitor
machines.summary: Reads moisture, slope, and thaw, then sets living soil beds on drained ground.

machines.name: Weather Manipulator
machines.summary: Sets a micro-climate shelter tuned to the ninety-day growing window.

machines.name: Gene Ark Rig
machines.summary: Carries catalog lines to a prepared bed: clone, spawn, or cultivate.

machines.name: Structure Builder
machines.summary: Lays streets, greenhouses, water works, and township modules from banked stone.
